verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Workers fits into Git/GitHub Actions workflows and supports CLI-based deploys plus rollbacks, implying CI/CD integration for git-push deploys, but there's no explicit first-party doc or hands-on account describing an automatic 'deploy on every git push' pipeline (e.g., Workers Builds) in this pack. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation/example of a git-integrated CI pipeline auto-triggering deploys, and independent user confirmation of this exact workflow.
